title: Field Trip Waiver Checklist
subtitle: Capture trip destination, transport, activity condition, and supervision; confirm guardian choice and return.
description: Field Trip Waiver records trip destination, transport, activity condition, supervision, guardian choice, and return. Field Trip Waiver evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this field trip waiver stage-gated verification when staff must document trip destination and transport. Reconcile activity condition, supervision, guardian choice, and return before the field trip waiver handoff. Use the itinerary, transportation plan, disclosed activity conditions, supervision roster, accessible alternative, participant questions, guardian choice, and return headcount. This acknowledgment concerns an excursion with bus or walking travel, off-site terrain, destination activities, chaperone supervision, group movement, and school return. Ask the assigned field trip waiver reviewer to confirm trip destination against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver contact and reference
sections.guidance: Disclose destination, transport conditions, walking or activity demands, supervision, available alternative, guardian choice, emergency route, and return. Record the field trip waiver decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

blocks.label: Field Trip Waiver people and reference

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current field trip waiver facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Field Trip Waiver required checks
items: Trip destination is identified for this record
Transport matches the current request or source
Activity condition is ready for point-of-use staff
Supervision limits or questions are resolved
Guardian choice is communicated to the responsible person
A changed field trip waiver fact is returned for review

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold field trip waiver readiness on any failed or pending item.
